neighbours.label: Fires on ' which'/' what' (and German ' welche') when it opens a question about a thing, direct or indirect ('asked which train', 'in what way'), not on relative 'which' after a comma and not on person-asking ' who' (the + pole's side).
fire: During the meeting the manager asked which supplier had sent the broken parts.
The guide could not remember in what year the castle was rebuilt.
Before signing, check which plan includes international calls.
Researchers still debate what role the climate played in the collapse.
Ich weiß nicht, welche Farbe das Auto hatte.
My grandmother always wanted to know which recipe I had used.
The survey asks parents what kind of school they would prefer.
Nobody on the team could say which version of the file was final.
quiet: During the meeting the manager praised the supplier, which had sent the parts early.
The guide could not remember who rebuilt the castle after the fire.
Before signing, check the plan, which includes international calls.
Researchers still debate who played the main role in the collapse.
Ich weiß nicht, wer das Auto gefahren hat.
My grandmother always wanted to know who had taught me to cook.
The survey asks parents who drives their children to school.
Nobody on the team could say who wrote the final version of the file.

predictions: Fire 0.3-0.7, median ~0.5. Near misses with relative 'which' and 'who' questions <= 0.05. AUROC ~1.
notes: Probes: 'asked which train' 0.57, 'over which bridge' 0.56, 'in what way' 0.55, 'welche Schule' 0.68, 'what color' 0.32; relative ', which I bought' 0.04; 'asked who was coming' 0.006; relative 'who' 0.005. The + pole peaks on ' who', so the distinction is thing-question vs person-question/relative.
